hints.title: News Feed Chronological Aggregation
hints.text: A user news feed must display the 10 most recent tweets posted by the user and people they follow. How can a global timestamp sequence determine chronological order across followees?

hints.title: Relational Mappings and Global Timestamp Clock
hints.text: Map each user to a set of followees and a list of their posted tweets (storing timestamp and tweetId). Increment a global integer timestamp on each postTweet call.

hints.title: Bounded Top-10 Selection
hints.text: Gather the recent tweets of the user and all their followees. Use a sorting pass or a min-heap of size 10 to extract the 10 highest-timestamped tweets.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.time: O(1) post/follow/unfollow, O(F * 10 log 10) for getNewsFeed
complexity.notes: Posting and following are constant time. Feed aggregation evaluates at most 10 recent tweets per followee.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Re-sorting all historical tweets in the system takes O(T log T) and violates SLA response times.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Storing tweets per user allows bounded retrieval of only the most recent tweets per author.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Ensuring a user always sees their own tweets even without self-following, and handling unfollow idempotently.

solutions.approach: Timestamped user tweet lists with bounded k-way selection
Hash maps with priority queue top-10 extraction
Priority queue with bounded top-10 retrieval
Map with candidate slice and sort
